Tick what applies. None of it blocks a review, it says where to look.

- [ ] It moves `render_fingerprint.json` or `pixel_baseline.json`, so a pass is owed. [What that costs](https://github.com/Alchez/terrella/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#changing-the-pipeline-without-the-render-store)
- [ ] AI assistance beyond autocomplete, with the tool named above.

First time here? [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Alchez/terrella/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) has the setup, the one gate command, and what no gate can check.
